facts.advisory_summary:
jackson-databind: InetSocketAddress deserialization triggers eager DNS resolution (SSRF) — ## Summary

expect.note: Needs attacker input to reach Thymeleaf as an expression or template. The app's templates come from classpath:/templates or operator customFiles/templates (FileFallbackTemplateResolver.java:19, AppConfig.java:42-44). View names are literals (controller/web/*), templates have no __${}__ preprocessing or dynamic ~{${...}} fragments (only ${param.status=='404'} comparisons, error.html:15-16), and nothing calls TemplateEngine.process on user strings.
